  "reasons": [
    "When bad debts occur, Bad Debts A/c is debited and Debtors A/c is credited for ₹15,000.",
    "Since an existing Provision for Doubtful Debts of ₹20,000 is available, the ₹15,000 bad debts are absorbed by and transferred to this provision: Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c Dr. ₹15,000 to Bad Debts A/c ₹15,000."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Admission of Partner",
  "syllabus_topic": "Revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities",

  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Debtors are ₹6,20,000 and existing provision for doubtful debts is ₹20,000.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Bad debts of ₹15,000 are written off against the existing provision.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E1.1", "E2.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "Debts are debited to revaluation to augment the provision account rather than writing off directly against existing provision.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "The write-off is charged directly to revaluation without adjusting against the existing provision for doubtful debts.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Bad debts are recorded by crediting the revaluation account.",

  ],

    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "Provision for doubtful debts A/c Dr. 3,000 To Bad debts A/c 3,000 (Bad debts adjusted against the provision",
      "reason": "Bad debts are credited to debtors and closed against the existing provision."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Then Revaluation A/c Dr ₹15,000; To Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c ₹15,000.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "When such a provision already exists, the loss due to bad debts during the current year are adjusted against the same",
      "reason": "Bad debts are adjusted against existing provision, not revaluation account."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Revaluation A/c Dr ₹15,000; To Debtors A/c ₹15,000.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "When such a provision already exists, the loss due to bad debts during the current year are adjusted against the same",
      "reason": "Existing provision must absorb bad debts before charging anything to revaluation."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "To Revaluation A/c ₹15,000.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "Bad debts A/c Dr. 1,000 31, 2017 To Sundry debtors 1,000",
      "reason": "Initial entry to write off bad debts credits debtors, not revaluation."
    }
  ]
